description: This file defines the ServiceCatalogClient class in the Aws\ServiceCatalog namespace, extending AwsClient. It includes method annotations for interacting with the AWS Service Catalog service, listing available API actions and their async counterparts.

classes.name: ServiceCatalogClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS Service Catalog API, providing methods to interact with AWS Service Catalog services such as creating, describing, listing, and deleting portfolios, products, and provisioning artifacts.

methods.name: acceptPortfolioShare
methods.description: Accepts a portfolio share from another AWS account.

methods.name: associateBudgetWithResource
methods.description: Associates a budget with a specific AWS resource.

methods.name: associatePrincipalWithPortfolio
methods.description: Associates a principal (IAM user, role, or group) with a portfolio.

methods.name: createPortfolio
methods.description: Creates a new AWS Service Catalog portfolio.

methods.name: describePortfolio
methods.description: Describes details of a specified portfolio.

methods.name: listPortfolios
methods.description: Lists all portfolios accessible to the user.
